note: Seeded by hand from Fused-Gaming/Fused-Gaming-Skill-MCP's published tool list. Run `node scripts/sync-registries.mjs` to refresh verifiedH4shed/latestKnownVersion/description from the live npm registry without losing the hand-set workspace/agent/category fields below. New tools discovered on npm that aren't yet in this file are appended automatically under source: "discovered", category: "uncategorized" — re-categorize them by hand, then they behave like any seed entry. Entries may also carry `npmPublished` (false for package-hub additions still pre-release), `bin` (the package's exposed npx-runnable commands, or null if none are exposed yet), and `workflow` (an anchor into `references/package-workflows.md` documenting how to actually run it) — see that file for the full per-package usage docs.
